workers.name: Investigator
workers.description: Reads one claim's crash bundle and returns the facts that matter for a counterfactual (speeds, gap, hazard type, AV braking, evidence tier) plus unknowns and red flags. Give it the claim_id.

workers.name: Reconstructor
workers.description: Checks that the simulator reproduces the reported crash for one claim and revises scenario ranges when it does not (max 5 attempts). Give it the claim_id and the investigator's facts.

workers.name: Counterfactual analyst
workers.description: Runs the Monte Carlo counterfactual for one claim (careful drivers A and B in the AV's seat), at the bundle's evidence tier and at a higher tier, and says what evidence would narrow the answer. Give it the claim_id.

orchestrator.name: Recovery portfolio lead
orchestrator.description: Works a queue of robotaxi crash claims for a UK motor insurer, delegates investigation, reconstruction and counterfactual analysis, prices recovery from the AV company, and keeps a portfolio summary.
